title: Snow Safety Check Weekly Check Time Trend
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=snow:safety check_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(check_minutes) as avg_duration, max(check_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst check time for snow safety check events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture check_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average check time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether snow safety check tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
